facts.params: &name as Type, with out and commas
facts.inheritance: Extends/implements Path.member of nearest public or protected-abstract declaration

title: App Designer writes signature comments into each method, get and set body when it saves an Application Class
statement: Saving an Application Class, App Designer replaces the /+ +/ lines after each method, get and set header with one line per parameter (&name as Type, out, a comma on all but the last), then Returns Type, then Extends/implements naming the nearest ancestor that declares the member publicly or protected and abstract. Types are canonical: array of array becomes Array2, a bare array Array of Any, classes their full path.

observations.observation: The rules reproduce 1,382 of 1,387 stored Application Class sources exactly; the remaining five carry comments left stale by later edits.
